thread:
ralph: heads up — deployed 'tight-pack-v1' to a 6-node canary at 11:41. early numbers look promising: p50 -11%, p95 -17%, p99 -21% on our chat mix; estimated token-cost down ~13%. :tada:

neha: nice! which workloads did you use for validation?

perfbot: run=perf_20240630_1141_canary, traces=chat_peak, chat_steady, small_batch_mixed; throughput +6%; kvcache_hit +5% for <64-token prefixes; report: https://perf.company/reports/perf_20240630_1141_canary

zoe: can you paste the key config diffs?

ralph: short snippet:
```
packer:
  policy: tight-pack
  bucket_bins: [16,32,64,128]
  prefer_est_out: true
burst_controller:
  mode: latency-first
  max_hold_ms: 60
```
The packer prefers tighter homogeneous packs and uses estimated output tokens to group requests. burst controller briefly holds micro-windows to avoid giant mismatched packs.

neha: did you check h2 multiplex and streaming tails?

ralph: multiplex p99 improved ~13ms on average; streaming p95 tightened. no e2e or safety regressions on the eval set.

opsbot: deploy event: canary:eng-runtime/tight-pack-v1 -> nodes:6 -> status: success -> ts=1746302468

neha: any fallbacks for long-form?

ralph: yes — est_out > 3000 tokens triggers legacy packer. also auto-disable smoothing if worker queue_latency > 150ms.

perfbot: note: small GC allocation spike during warmup observed, duration ~180ms; not impacting p99. Logged under perf/gc/1746302468.

zoe: rollout plan?

ralph: +50% capacity in 8h, full flip 36h if no anomalies. I'll draft a short blurb for #eng-release-notes after full flip. tagging @oncall for AM verification. :rocket:
